import html # Template for a blog post; placeholders are {title} and {body} BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user-generated blog post safely for display in a web page. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML snippet containing the title and body. """ # Escape user-provided input to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Return the formatted HTML return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
